extension.name: Ember Time
extension.description: Ember vscode plugin. Statistical analysis of code time.
config.title: Ember Time
config.statusBarInfo.description: Select the information showing in the status bar.
config.serverEntrypoint.description: Server entrypoint defines the URL for reporting data to a server.
config.proxy.description: Proxy URL for API requests, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080. Leave empty to use system proxy environment variables (HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY).
config.obfuscateFilenames.description: Obfuscate file paths in recorded activity for privacy protection.
config.ignoreProjects.description: List of project names or patterns to ignore during tracking.
config.heartbeatInterval.description: Interval in seconds to batch and sync events to the server.
codetime.displayLanguage.title: Display Language
codetime.displayLanguage.description: Select the display language for the Ember Time extension.
